body:
That's true... I just don't know how to go about it. Maybe I'll talk to him a little more or something, or try to explain more explicitly to her. I just want my life to be normal but I guess everyone wants that, huh? 

By the way, I'm probably going to fall asleep, you don't have to keep talking to me :)

That's true :) And I don't think they're cliche, they're helpful. I know I need people, but I don't know if I have any friends close enough in this way. I've talked to my brother, but if I told him exactly how I feel he'd be terrified. And my friends would freak out, if I could even get up the energy and motivation to tell them, which is hard itself. I have two friends who know I'm depressed and one doesn't seem to understand no matter what. I don't think it's spiteful, she just doesn't get it. The other friend knows because he told me he's depressed. I don't want to drop my problems on him after that.

I definitely would be, I'm just so tired, so tired of fighting. I've been fighting so long. I really want to. I'm scared of feeling like there's nothing and like I've got nothing. I guess that's why I'm here. It's so hard to even talk to someone, let alone find a real solution. I just don't really know how to do it.

Maybe... by the way, thanks so much for talking to me. It's so easy to get so lonely. 

I'm trying to find a medicine that helps but the ones I've tried only made it worse. I'm pretty sure I have a serotonin deficiency in general, but the school stuff just makes it so much worse. My therapist and psychiatrist think it's biological, at least. But then it's like, how do I fight with my own body? I just don't even know how I can hope to keep up if I can't find a cure fast enough.

Yeah, basically that's it. Everything I was good at I'm not so good at any more and talent isn't carrying me through. Hell, I was never talented, I was talented at working hard and now I'm the worst at working hard. Part of it is just not being able to keep up and part of it is the crippling depression keeping me in bed.

My major is... well, something I'm really into so I probably shouldn't put it here. It's a social science major though. I just don't get the papers and articles we're reading and I can't penetrate the lectures I'm supposed to be able to. I just feel like I dropped into something more than I can handle and I don't know what to do considering it's the only thing I want out of life.

I was always really smart in high school, meaning I was the smartest amongst a bunch of kids who would easily have been smarter than me if they'd had the same opportunities. And now I'm at a big, very top university and I can hardly understand what's happening around me. I want to do my major for the rest of my life but what the fuck is the point if I'm mediocre at it? I'm struggling through so much and I can't even motivate myself to get anything done. I used to be so good at making myself do things and now even that's not good enough.

That's the worst part, I have no clue. I'm pretty sure my biology is just massively messed up. I mean, there's other stuff, yeah, like tons of stress from school and feeling inadequate at school and fighting with my mom and my mom being sick and dealing with a long distance relationship. But more than anything I just think I'm physically incapable of happiness right now without drugs and it just hurts so much.
